# Evidence
- Problem class: walkthrough-dismissal-not-persisted-identity-key-instability
- Model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
- Solved: 2026-09-14T13:59:55.803Z
- Verification: solution produced by pi in sandbox; see signatures.json

signatures.description: Next.js global onboarding walkthrough (ContextualWalkthrough, localStorage key embedding userId||'anonymous' + role): Dismiss writes status:'dismissed' but the dialog reappears on every navigation. Root cause: identity instability across mounts — props ?? auth-store ?? localStorage fallback chain used nullish coalescing, so an empty-string userId/role from the auth store during hydration masked the localStorage fallback and the storage key flipped between mounts (dismissal written under one key, read under another). Fix: use || (falsy) fallbacks so empty strings fall through, initialize progress to null until client-side read (SSR-safe), and suppress the overlay on quiz take routes via isWalkthroughSuppressedRoute(pathname). Verified live: dismiss -> navigate -> dialog stays gone; /quiz/<real-id>/take renders with no overlay.
